title: Night sail
headline: The picture that started this: a sailboat under a full moon.
note: Made before the news feed began, as the test of whether letters two pixels wide could pass for a photograph.

title: The catch
headline: SpaceX caught a Starship coming back from orbit in its launch tower's arms, a first for the program.
note: The ship returned on Saturday after 14 orbits and 22 hours in space. The picture is its last few seconds, engines lit, settling between the arms.

title: The swell
headline: Forecasters warned of the biggest waves in years along Northern California's coast, with swell after swell due through Thanksgiving week.
note: Storms in the Gulf of Alaska are driving them, and breakers of 30 to 40 feet were called possible. The picture imagines one meeting a lighthouse headland.

title: Three chairs
headline: Trump, Putin and Xi are expected to sit down together for the first time, at this week's APEC summit in Shenzhen.
note: Trump has said ending the Iran war and denuclearization are on his agenda. The picture leaves the seats empty: a table set for three above a city at night.

title: Under the lights
headline: Monday Night Football brings the Chargers to Baltimore tonight to face the Ravens, closing the NFL's Week 10.
note: Kickoff was at 8:15 p.m. Eastern. The picture is an imagined stadium at night, seen from behind the goalposts.

title: Leonids
headline: The Leonid meteor shower peaks tomorrow night, with about 10 to 15 meteors an hour under dark skies.
note: The half-lit moon sets before midnight, and the hours before dawn are best. The picture has them streaking out of Leo above a ridge of pines.

title: Short of orbit
headline: A Vulcan rocket failed about 10 minutes after leaving Florida on Sunday, losing all 40 Amazon Leo internet satellites on board, its maker ULA said.
note: It was the rocket's first flight in nine months. The picture is an imagined launch trail over the coast that never finishes its arc.

title: Back in the air
headline: Flights across the United States were largely back to normal on Monday, three days after a communications outage led the FAA to halt departures nationwide for more than four hours.
note: Officials point to router trouble at FAA sites in Arkansas and Texas as the likely trigger, and the investigation continues. The picture has one airliner climbing away at dusk over a queue still waiting its turn.

title: To the sea
headline: On Australia's Christmas Island the yearly march of the red crabs is under way: tens of millions are leaving the rainforest for the coast to breed.
note: The wet season's first big rains set them off, and they are crossing roads and purpose-built bridges on the way down. The picture has them pouring along a forest track to a moonlit sea.

title: Going, going
headline: Sotheby's opened New York's big November art sales on Monday night with two auctions that brought in $378.7 million, among them a record $15 million, with fees, for a 1960 work by Yayoi Kusama.
note: The night began with a single-owner collection in which every work sold. The picture leaves the canvas blank and shows the paddles going up.
